svg.title: BIM Standards - Model Requirements v2.1
svg.text: Model standards written as BIM Coordinator · baseline for every new client project
Section 4.2 Required parameters and LOD by equipment type
Every model delivered to a client project must meet this table before it is accepted (see 4.1 Model setup checklist).
Equipment mark: <TYPE>-<BLDG><SEQ> e.g. EP-E2, AHU-E1, B-2
Shared coordinates: acquired from the site survey model; survey point locked, project base point at grid A/1.
